```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Override version (e.g. v2.28.0). Leave empty to auto-bump.'
        required: false
        default: ''
      bump:
        description: 'Bump type (patch/minor/major) if version is empty'
        required: false
        default: 'minor'
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 'stable'

      - name: Run tests
        run: go test ./...

      - name: Determine version
        id: version
        run: |
          INPUT_VERSION="${{ github.event.inputs.version }}"
          INPUT_BUMP="${{ github.event.inputs.bump }}"
          
          if [ -n "$INPUT_VERSION" ]; then
            VERSION="$INPUT_VERSION"
          else
            LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "v0.0.0")
            BUMP="$INPUT_BUMP"
            
            # Parse version parts
            VERSION_NUM=${LATEST_TAG#v}
            IFS='.' read -r MAJOR MINOR PATCH <<< "$VERSION_NUM"
            
            # Bump logic
            case "$BUMP" in
              major)
                MAJOR=$((MAJOR + 1))
                MINOR=0
                PATCH=0
                ;;
              minor)
                MINOR=$((MINOR + 1))
                PATCH=0
                ;;
              patch)
                PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
                ;;
            esac
            
            VERSION="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
          fi
          
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Using version: $VERSION"

      - name: Install git-cliff
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: git-cliff@2.12.0

      - name: Generate CHANGELOG
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          git cliff --tag "$VERSION" --latest --strip header > CHANGELOG.md
          echo "Generated CHANGELOG.md:"
          cat CHANGELOG.md

      - name: Commit CHANGELOG and Tag
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git add CHANGELOG.md
          git commit -m "chore: update CHANGELOG for $VERSION" || echo "No changes to commit"
          
          git tag "$VERSION"
          git push origin main "$VERSION"

      - name: Run GoReleaser
        uses: goreleaser/goreleaser-action@v6
        with:
          distribution: goreleaser
          version: '~> v2'
          args: release --clean
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
